correctness.rationale: The forbidden 2x2 permutation patterns are equivalent to row-inclusion comparability. Complement closure pairs lonesum matrices; using the known |L_mn| Stirling sum, its j=0,1 contributions give 2 mod 4 and j>=2 terms vanish mod 4. Thus every even-weight Walsh coefficient is 2 mod 4 and every odd-weight coefficient is zero for all m,n>=2. A fresh independent 65536-entry transform of 6902 exact 4x4 nested-row matrices gave zero count 32768, 34 distinct positive levels, minimum absolute coefficient 6 attained 6360 times, and 6 mod 16 on every even-weight coefficient. The inspected checker independently verifies all 317 row-column frequency orbits by direct 6902-term sums and checks the preceding 2x2,3x3 minima 2. Fourier diagonalization gives pseudoinverse 1/6 and condition 6902/6 =3451/3. Completeness is finite for the 4x4 magnitude census, not all sizes.
